name: mmo-cr-frontend-tests
description: Playwright BDD E2E test suite for MMO-CR external frontend
author: Defra DDTS

scripts.git:pre-commit-hook: npm run format:check && npm run lint
scripts.setup:husky: node -e "try { (await import('husky')).default() } catch (e) { if (e.code !== 'ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND') throw e }" --input-type module
scripts.generate:report: allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report && allure open allure-report

devDependencies.test: npm run clean && npm run bddgen && playwright test
devDependencies.test:smoke: npm run clean && npm run bddgen && playwright test --grep @smoke
devDependencies.test:regression: npm run clean && npm run bddgen && playwright test --grep @regression
devDependencies.test:local: npm run clean && npm run bddgen && playwright test --headed
devDependencies.test:local:debug: npm run clean && npm run bddgen && PWDEBUG=1 playwright test
devDependencies.git:pre-commit-hook: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
devDependencies.setup:husky: node -e "try { require('husky')() } catch(e) { if (e.code !== 'MODULE_NOT_FOUND') throw e }"
